questions.question: What does successful retrieval on the training pairs establish?
options: The encoder solves those pairs under that pairing and augmentation contract.
Lowering the temperature parameter \(\tau\) improves the nearest-neighbor ranking order of the cosine matrix.
Diagonal-only supervision automatically merges duplicate semantic examples into a single positive target.
